lines: Swallowed... in the darkness of the sea.
Hazrat Yunus, alayhis salaam, was thrown into a stormy sea... and a huge fish swallowed him.
Darkness of the night. Darkness of the sea. Darkness inside the fish.
And from that darkness he called out: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I was among the wrongdoers.
And Allah saved him. And He says: this is how We save the believers.
